title: ICC-ES ESR-2092: Nudura insulating concrete form (ICF) wall system

facts.text: Report holder shown as TREMCO CPG INC.; evaluation subject is the Nudura Insulating Concrete Form (ICF) System.

Forms are stay-in-place formwork for load-bearing and non-load-bearing, below- and above-grade walls; they may be used in fire-resistance-rated construction provided installation follows §4.4, in Type V construction, and in Types I-IV (noncombustible) construction under §4.5.
ICFs must be manufactured, identified and installed per the report and Nudura's published installation instructions; the report governs a conflict.
Calculations for the §4.1.1 design must be submitted when the code official requires them, and must be prepared by a registered design professional where the jurisdiction's statutes require.
Calculations for IRC Sections R404.1.3.3.6 and R608.5.3 must be submitted when the code official requires them.
Ultimate shear values in Table 2 from ASTM E2126 testing 'are not intended for use as design values'; applicability is for the registered design professional, subject to building official approval.
Forms are produced in Columbus, Georgia, USA, and Granby, Quebec, Canada, under quality control (manufacturing-location statement only).
Evidence listed: AC353 (24), published April 2025, and cyclic shear wall testing per ASTM E2126.
